card.name: The word countless before a noun
card.fires_on: The word "countless" (or "less" in Count-less) used as a vague large-quantity word before a plural noun like hours, species or molecules, in general web prose. Weaker on "n" or "N" in table headers.

modes.label: Countless quantity
modes.description: "Countless" placed before a plural noun to mean a huge unspecified number.
